en:
When you arrived, Shapiro began to go through some old guild contacts he had, and quickly found himself a fairly discreet position in a Tsarathi guild sect.

Though the facilities are not as convenient as he was previously used to, he found the differences in approach and attitude to be both fascinating and liberating, and manages to conduct his research more freely than before.

He is currently mentoring several young orcs as apprentices, and on the rare occasion when you see him, he speaks of them incessantly.

He is often critical of their progress, but he is clearly glad to have students once again, and overall he seems happy with his life.

en:
Vankan was nigh inconsolable after the death of Leviathan, sobbing for hours on end.

For whatever reason, he seemed to have been damaged directly by the divine beast's death, and he crawled back into the Bath alone, prostrating himself before Leviathan's body and begging the heavens for forgiveness.

You gave him some time, but he told you to leave him there, and eventually you were forced to do exactly that.

He did not follow you or turn up at your stronghold later, and you do not know what happened to him.

en:
Vankan was nearly catatonic with grief after you emerged from the Bath. You spent a lot of time comforting him and helping him work through it, and when you finally concluded that Vankan's third eye had made him particularly sensitive to the divine beast's death, he became suddenly very eager to leave the island.

He seemed to practically hold his breath for the entire effort of the ship repair, and when you were finally out at sea with the island far behind you, he laid down on the deck and slept peacefully for the first time in weeks.

Vankan eventually found a place as a healer in a small town with a need of one, his unique gift making him a popular man for setting minds at ease as well as mending bodies. Over time, he has found his visions easier to translate into sensible advice, and he is pleased to finally have found a sense of normalcy.

en:
Wisaka was leery of the expedition, knowing that lycanthropes are often hunted and killed in mainland communities, so he ultimately decided to remain on the island.

Though he considered going to Hayill, he didn't much care for their ongoing struggle with the Knightwood vampires, so he instead headed for Bracewind and hired on at the Pumphouse Brewery.

Now he plays music for patrons, earning his way in tips, and occasionally taking adventuresome clients of his own.

en:
Whether because of his daring or because of his naivete, Wisaka was enthusiastic about the trip to the mainland, and indeed, when he arrived, he made a spectacle of himself almost immediately.

Unsure how to react at first, a shocked crowd gathered as Wisaka began to sing and play music, and by the time the guards arrived to see what the commotion was, people were cheering and throwing him spare coins.

He now has a sort of probationary allowance to live and work in town, and he takes full advantage of it, cheerfully socializing with the locals and frequently answering invitations to perform, as curious crowds from far and wide whisper wild rumours of "The Howling Bard".

en:
Zantanak cloaked himself in dark cloth and remained your servant and bodyguard once you arrived in Tsarath.

With his guidance, you were eventually able to find the headquarters of a small cult that you readily impressed into your service.

He is a constant voice, ever urging you to gather more power, more followers, and more forbidden knowledge.

en:
Though he did not relish the idea of covering his face and body, Zantanak put on a low profile once you arrived in Tsarath, and did his best not to cause you undue trouble.

At his direction, you found the headquarters of a small cult and readily convinced them to serve you, eventually forming a small community where Zantanak hides his face only from outside visitors.

Eventually, once your commune was well-established, he asked for your permission to take a harem, and seeing that there were several cultists eager to fill the role, you allowed it.

He is nearly as protective of his wives as he is of you, and he is a much feared, respected, and admired member of your growing faith.

en: Cycle through party members with TAB, or press 1-4 to select them directly!
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:810  list.Add("Cycle through party members with TAB, or press 1-4 to select them directly!");

en: You can safely use a reckless attack with the SHIFT key when you have no risk!
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:811  list.Add("You can safely use a reckless attack with the SHIFT key when you have no risk!");

en:
If you share alignment with party members,
your reckless actions are less likely to fumble!
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:812  list.Add("If you share alignment with party members,\nyour reckless actions are less likely to fumble!");

en: Food is plentiful and cheap, so use it when you need it.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:813  list.Add("Food is plentiful and cheap, so use it when you need it.");

en:
Did you know you can customize your characters' sprites completely?
Check the Readme.txt for details.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:814  list.Add("Did you know you can customize your characters' sprites completely?\nCheck the Readme.txt for details.");

en: Negative effects like poison disappear after combat.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:815  list.Add("Negative effects like poison disappear after combat.");

en: You can try to conscript enemy creatures into your party when they hesitate in combat.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:816  list.Add("You can try to conscript enemy creatures into your party when they hesitate in combat.");

en: You need special skills in order to negotiate with animals or mindless creatures.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:817  list.Add("You need special skills in order to negotiate with animals or mindless creatures.");
OverworldScript.cs:818  list.Add("Some enemies will never hesitate.");

en: Utility skills can improve the success rate of ransom and recruit attempts.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:819  list.Add("Utility skills can improve the success rate of ransom and recruit attempts.");

en: Skills that improve negotiations only apply for the person who has the skill!
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:820  list.Add("Skills that improve negotiations only apply for the person who has the skill!");

en: Successful ransom attempts can grant many rare and high quality items.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:821  list.Add("Successful ransom attempts can grant many rare and high quality items.");

en: Keep a blacksmith in your stronghold in order to improve your equipment.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:822  list.Add("Keep a blacksmith in your stronghold in order to improve your equipment.");

en:
Gems can be used to improve grimoires, staves, and rings, 
or equipped as accessories on their own.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:823  list.Add("Gems can be used to improve grimoires, staves, and rings, \nor equipped as accessories on their own.");

en: Appraisers improve prices in your stronghold and help unwanted items to sell faster.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:824  list.Add("Appraisers improve prices in your stronghold and help unwanted items to sell faster.");

en: Have a chat with your quartermaster if you aren't sure what to do next.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:825  list.Add("Have a chat with your quartermaster if you aren't sure what to do next.");

en: If you lost your quartermaster, your items are not gone! Just hire another one.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:826  list.Add("If you lost your quartermaster, your items are not gone! Just hire another one.");

en:
A porter's extra inventory space is available even while exploring!
You can hire up to three of them at once.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:827  list.Add("A porter's extra inventory space is available even while exploring!\nYou can hire up to three of them at once.");

en: Can't find a key? Hire a locksmith, and you can buy whatever keys you need.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:828  list.Add("Can't find a key? Hire a locksmith, and you can buy whatever keys you need.");

en:
There is no way to force recovery for incapacitated band members, 
but hiring healers at your stronghold will help.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:829  list.Add("There is no way to force recovery for incapacitated band members, \nbut hiring healers at your stronghold will help.");

en:
Merchants come and go, so check back at your stronghold regularly 
to see if the selection has changed.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:830  list.Add("Merchants come and go, so check back at your stronghold regularly \nto see if the selection has changed.");

en:
Don't stand close to someone with the Unsettling, Nightmarish, or Alluring qualities,
even if they are allies.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:831  list.Add("Don't stand close to someone with the Unsettling, Nightmarish, or Alluring qualities,\neven if they are allies.");

en: Most nonhuman creatures are vulnerable to a particular magic vein.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:832  list.Add("Most nonhuman creatures are vulnerable to a particular magic vein.");

en: The BLAST skill "Imarcus" allows you to heal allies from a great distance.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:833  list.Add("The BLAST skill \"Imarcus\" allows you to heal allies from a great distance.");

en: The WARD skill "Healing Aura" offers basic, short-range healing for all nearby allies.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:834  list.Add("The WARD skill \"Healing Aura\" offers basic, short-range healing for all nearby allies.");

en: Equipment with the Wasting trait will slowly erode your hit points in combat.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:835  list.Add("Equipment with the Wasting trait will slowly erode your hit points in combat.");

en: All risk is eliminated when a new combat round starts.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:836  list.Add("All risk is eliminated when a new combat round starts.");

en: Invulnerability can be triggered once per combat.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:837  list.Add("Invulnerability can be triggered once per combat.");

en:
Manpower is important! 
Keep improving it in order to take larger strongholds and recruit more people.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:838  list.Add("Manpower is important! \nKeep improving it in order to take larger strongholds and recruit more people.");

en:
If you leave a secured map alone long enough,
it may not still be empty when you return.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:839  list.Add("If you leave a secured map alone long enough,\nit may not still be empty when you return.");

en: Any character you have created previously can turn up at random.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:840  list.Add("Any character you have created previously can turn up at random.");

en: Lawful people contribute their highest utility skill as manpower.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:841  list.Add("Lawful people contribute their highest utility skill as manpower.");

en: Neutral people contribute their utility score squared as manpower.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:842  list.Add("Neutral people contribute their utility score squared as manpower.");

en: Chaotic people contribute their second-highest skill as manpower.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:843  list.Add("Chaotic people contribute their second-highest skill as manpower.");

en: Certain high-level utility skills will significantly boost manpower contributions.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:844  list.Add("Certain high-level utility skills will significantly boost manpower contributions.");

en: Incapacitated party members still take up space at your stronghold!
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:845  list.Add("Incapacitated party members still take up space at your stronghold!");

en: You can have conversations with your bandmates at your stronghold.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:846  list.Add("You can have conversations with your bandmates at your stronghold.");

en: Bandmates won't trust you if you don't talk to them on occasion.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:847  list.Add("Bandmates won't trust you if you don't talk to them on occasion.");

en: You have to level up bandmates if you expect them to trust you.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:848  list.Add("You have to level up bandmates if you expect them to trust you.");

en:
You have a chance to heal incapacitated bandmates
and sell items after gaining any amount of experience.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:849  list.Add("You have a chance to heal incapacitated bandmates\nand sell items after gaining any amount of experience.");

en: Some characters hate each other, and cannot be in your band together.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:850  list.Add("Some characters hate each other, and cannot be in your band together.");

en:
The "physical" and "magical" equipment traits 
improve damage dealt in combat.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:851  list.Add("The \"physical\" and \"magical\" equipment traits \nimprove damage dealt in combat.");

en:
The "threat" and "critical" equipment traits 
improve the frequency and severity of critical hits.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:852  list.Add("The \"threat\" and \"critical\" equipment traits \nimprove the frequency and severity of critical hits.");

en:
"Mana" changes your magical output, and "align" changes your magical resistances.
"Soul" does both.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:853  list.Add("\"Mana\" changes your magical output, and \"align\" changes your magical resistances.\n\"Soul\" does both.");

en: Dismissed bandmates will not appear again in your current playthrough.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:854  list.Add("Dismissed bandmates will not appear again in your current playthrough.");

en:
Press "F" or use the side button to toggle whether or not 
your bandmates try to follow the active character.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:855  list.Add("Press \"F\" or use the side button to toggle whether or not \nyour bandmates try to follow the active character.");

en: Press "C" or use the side button to call your bandmates to your side.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:856  list.Add("Press \"C\" or use the side button to call your bandmates to your side.");

en:
Out-of-combat movement speed and inventory positioning 
can be adjusted in the options menu.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:857  list.Add("Out-of-combat movement speed and inventory positioning \ncan be adjusted in the options menu.");

en: Disable follow mode to move and position party members individually.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:858  list.Add("Disable follow mode to move and position party members individually.");

en: You can attack neutral and hesitating creatures by using a reckless action.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:859  list.Add("You can attack neutral and hesitating creatures by using a reckless action.");

en:
Crest and Tsarath both count humans and orcs among their citizens.
Before your incarceration, you were a citizen of Crest.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:860  list.Add("Crest and Tsarath both count humans and orcs among their citizens.\nBefore your incarceration, you were a citizen of Crest.");

en: Some bandmates can only be found by making specific character creation choices.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:861  list.Add("Some bandmates can only be found by making specific character creation choices.");

en: You will begin with a different personal skill depending on your crime and your guilt.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:862  list.Add("You will begin with a different personal skill depending on your crime and your guilt.");

en: Press "B" or use the side button to view your list of learned skills.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:863  list.Add("Press \"B\" or use the side button to view your list of learned skills.");

en: Some special scenarios can only be found if the people involved trust you.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:864  list.Add("Some special scenarios can only be found if the people involved trust you.");

en: You need to gain some experience before your stronghold service providers will appear.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:865  list.Add("You need to gain some experience before your stronghold service providers will appear.");

en:
Stronghold service providers need a place to sleep too!
You won't be able to recruit more allies if you have no vacancies in your stronghold!
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:866  list.Add("Stronghold service providers need a place to sleep too!\nYou won't be able to recruit more allies if you have no vacancies in your stronghold!");

en:
Not all strongholds are created equal!
Even areas with the same capacity often have different upkeep costs.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:867  list.Add("Not all strongholds are created equal!\nEven areas with the same capacity often have different upkeep costs.");

en:
Many puzzles require items from different maps to complete.
If you get stuck, try exploring elsewhere and coming back later.
ctx: OverworldScript.cs:868  list.Add("Many puzzles require items from different maps to complete.\nIf you get stuck, try exploring elsewhere and coming back later.");
